video_title: Pat Bev PAID 2 MILLION to get into the NBA and he was IN DEBT 🤯

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on the perception of his beef with Russell Westbrook
quotes.excerpt: a lot of people at one point thought y'all was beefing at one point

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: Speaking of Russell Westbrook at the time, I remember at the time a lot of people at one point thought y'all was beefing at one point. How refreshing was it to even become a teammate with bro at the time?

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: We started, our beef started, I was with Houston Rockets, he was with OKC. Exactly. My first year in the NBA, I come from overseas, Russia, to the NBA middle of the season. Houston Rockets playing the Bulls. They say he want to meet the team in Chicago. I tell him hell no. I'm just going to wait in Houston.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on paying his own buyout to join the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I paid my own money to get to the NBA, bro. All the money I ever made
quotes.quote: I'm officially in the NBA now. I'm broke as hell. I got to get all this money back. My buyout, $1.7 million. The NBA can only pay $450,000. I had to pay the rest. I put myself in debt coming to the league. I paid my own money to get to the NBA, bro. All the money I ever made overseas, I had to get all that shit back. I came to the NBA with like $7,000 in my pocket.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on being cut by the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: they cut me because I'm the cheapest person on the totem pole they go get Jerry Stackhouse
quotes.quote: I got cut. The Miami Heat story, I went there and I got cut from them. Mike Miller get hurt. They cut me because I'm the cheapest person on the totem pole they go get Jerry Stackhouse. That's how they got Stackhouse to tell you. They replaced me for Stack. Low man on the totem pole, you make the cheapest money, get him out of there.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on signing a lucrative contract in Russia
quotes.excerpt: I signed the biggest contract I ever had in Russia. I'm the second highest paid American
quotes.quote: So mind you, I got to go overseas again. So now I'm in Russia. I signed in Russia. I signed the biggest contract I ever had in Russia. I signed the biggest contract. I'm the second highest paid American in Eastern Europe and Europe. I got $1.6 million a year. I'm 22 years old.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on signing a non-guaranteed contract with the Houston Rockets
quotes.excerpt: I signed a non-guaranteed contract with the Rockets, bro. Anytime I break my ankle, my career is
quotes.quote: I signed a non-guaranteed contract with the Rockets, bro. Anytime I break my ankle, my career is absolutely shattered, over with. I'm in a hole $2 million. I signed a three-year non-guaranteed. My first three years, all non-guaranteed. Anytime, ACL, Achilles, anytime it's over with. It's over with. I ain't got to doubt my name. I didn't gave all my money up and I'm $2 million in debt.

quotes.speaker: Patrick Beverley
quotes.summary_phrase: Patrick Beverley on James Harden's trade from OKC
quotes.excerpt: I didn't understand like what James meant to OKC because they just traded him

text_blocks.speaker: Patrick Beverley
text_blocks.text: I didn't understand like what James meant to OKC because they just traded him but like, he still cool with them. Like what the fuck going on here? That shit weird. I don't know what the fuck going on. Chandler Parsons, all the white girls want Chandler Parsons. Every time we land somewhere, people want Chandler Parsons. I'm like what the fuck going on? Jalen Brunson right here, every time we go somewhere, it's a thousand Asian people. 1,000 Asian people at the bus every night we land. I'm like what is going on? James Harden is James Harden, he rockstar out. He doing his thing, triple-double, triple-double, triple-double. I'm like bro, what the fuck is going on?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Randolph
text_blocks.text: James Harden is James Harden, he rockstar out.
